title: Grateful Dead Live at Ice Palace on 1969-03-29
lineage: Dat (Tascam DA-20) -> Tascam SS-R05 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a 1969 show highlighted by a monster Dark Star and high‑energy playing.
ai_review.review: The archive’s soundboard capture is crystal‑clear for its era, with the mix putting Jerry Garcia’s soaring leads front‑and‑center. Most listeners rave about the incendiary Dark Star and an overall “on fire” band vibe, though a few note off‑key vocals and a slightly loose feel in parts of the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are 4–5 stars praising both the music (especially Dark Star) and the audio quality; only one moderate‑rated review points out vocal flaws, and a single non‑sequitur low rating does not outweigh the overall enthusiasm.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly call the sound "ridiculously good" and note a clean mix that highlights Garcia's guitar; no major drop‑outs or muffiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set revolves around an expansive Dark Star that drives the energy, with a generally loose but engaging pacing throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Leads are praised as phenomenal and front‑and‑center in the mix; vocals receive mixed feedback – some call them perfect while others describe them as off‑key and immature.
